# Frozen producer compatibility corpus

These synthetic ciphertext bytes were produced by actual prepareFullModelResults
with the crypto files pinned in fixture.json at09cc699627862c958510572152b416f5d873e769.
They are not regenerated by the reader test, so an accidental simultaneous rewrite
of producer and reader AAD cannot make this regression self-consistent.

The fixture master is PUBLIC test-only: reader-fixture followed by64hex d chars.
No production key or secret value is present. The checked fixture contains only
synthetic prose, encrypted objects and metadata. The long object's suggested
model state is done, while the qualified claim state is active.

To regenerate deliberately, use a clean own09cc producer checkout with its real
dependencies, set HISTORY_SUMMARY_PRODUCER_ROOT to it, and run from this repo:
bun packages/session-read-worker/scripts/generate-history-summary-fixture.ts NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
The script refuses other HEADs/existing output and never accesses real services.
Review changed bytes/hashes/provenance before replacing this frozen corpus.
